#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int solve(int n, int mod) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    int last_result = 17;
    int result = 17;
    int max_size = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int toggle = 1;
    std::vector<std::vector<long long>> rec(2, std::vector<long long>(max_size + 1, 0));
    rec[0][0] = 1;
    rec[0][1] = 2;
    rec[0][2] = 2;
    rec[0][3] = 1;
    for (int m = 4; m < n; ++m) {
        long long total_pairs = (long long)m * (m - 1) / 2;
        result = (m + 1) * last_result;
        long long partial_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            partial_sum += rec[toggle ^ 1][i];
            rec[toggle][i] = partial_sum % mod;
        }
        for (int i = m; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            partial_sum += rec[toggle ^ 1][i];
            partial_sum -= rec[toggle ^ 1][i - m];
            rec[toggle][i] = partial_sum % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            rec[toggle][total_pairs - i] = rec[toggle][i];
        }
        long long total = 0;
        for (long long i = 0; i < total_pairs; ++i) {
            long long temp_sum = 0;
            long long start_idx = std::max(1LL, -total_pairs + i + m + 2);
            for (long long j = start_idx; j <= m; ++j) {
                temp_sum += j * rec[toggle][m + 2 - j + i];
            }
            total += rec[toggle][i];
            total %= mod;
            temp_sum %= mod;
            result += (temp_sum * total) % mod;
            result %= mod;
        }
        last_result = result;
        toggle ^= 1;
    }
    return result % mod;
}

int main() {
    int n, mod;
    std::cin >> n >> mod;
    std::cout << solve(n, mod) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
